overloadMerges.note: The two doc syntax lines differ only in whether the leading '*' is passed (selecting whether object is a name-string vs. a Variable/Field reference); collapsed into one overload with an optional literal-symbol discriminator.

params.name: asObjectName
params.description: If specified, object is an object name (string); if omitted, object is a variable or a field.

params.name: object
params.description: Object name (if * is specified) or Variable or field (if * is omitted)

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Sets the font size (in points) used to display the object(s) designated by object and *, for the current process.

constraints: size must be between 1 and 255; if the exact size is unavailable, characters are scaled.
The object's on-form area must be large enough for the new size, otherwise the text may be truncated or not displayed at all.
Applying this command to an object that was using a style sheet automatically removes the style-sheet reference from the object, even if the assigned size matches the style sheet's.
